name: lean-prompt
description: Keep every tool callable while shrinking the resident prompt: MCP servers are fronted by the lean-proxy meta-tools (catalog/describe/call) instead of every upstream schema being resident, knowledge moves to on-demand skills, and sub-agents stay available for output isolation.

interface.shortDescription: Full tool capability, compressed resident schemas
interface.longDescription: Fronts your MCP servers with lean-proxy, which keeps three compact meta-tools (catalog/describe/call) resident instead of every upstream tool declaration; every tool stays callable. Ships a full-fidelity main agent (default), specialist sub-agents for output isolation, an experimental minimal router profile, and a prompt-audit skill that measures what actually occupies your context.
